E6.full_invariant_cubic_singlet_ring: C[x*y*z] in the selected three singlet charge directions
E6.superpotential: W=lambda*I+kappa*I^2/Lambda^3, I=barH*A*H has canonical mass dimension3
E6.natural_O1_example: lambda=1, kappa=-1/2 => |I|/Lambda^3=1; for equal-magnitude singlet VEVs with normalized cubic contraction, |v|/Lambda=1
E6.extra_dimension9_operator: eta*I^3/Lambda^6, derivative delta f'=3 eta I^2/Lambda^6
E6.renormalizable_truncation: The chosen cubic I is renormalizable; I^2 is a dimension-six superpotential monomial with dimensionful coefficient Lambda^-3, and I^3 is dimension-nine. Other independent E6 invariants may supply a different vacuum.
E6.scope: A Wilsonian control warning for the particular stationary f(I)=lambda I+kappa I²/Lambda³ toy. At u~1 truncating higher powers without symmetry or an explicit UV completion is not parametrically justified. It does not prove all E6 gauge vacua are unstable; canonical normalization and cubic contraction coefficients matter.

three_time_Beyer_protocol.prior_art: Beyer et al, Observation of Genuine Multi-Time Quantum Memory, arXiv:2611.17268v1 2026-11-12; pairwise-classical dynamics and witness theorem are theirs.
three_time_Beyer_protocol.witness: W3<=sqrt(1-eta2²)+sqrt(1-eta3²)-gamma, when a z-displacing first channel and x,z-preserving later channels are followed by isotropic depolarization
three_time_Beyer_protocol.three_setting_design: (1) input maximally mixed -> measure z after amplitude damping: mean gamma; (2) input |0> -> measure z after z-dephasing+depolarization: mean eta2; (3) input |+> -> measure x after x-dephasing+depolarization: mean eta3
three_time_Beyer_protocol.pairwise_classical_condition: p >=(1-sqrt(1-gamma))/2; later random-unitary depolarization on the later channels preserves explicit pairwise decompositions, using tracked Pauli corrections for pair (E2,E3)
three_time_Beyer_protocol.noise_optimization: For gamma near1, eta_equal_threshold approaches sqrt(3)/2 (~0.866), much less stringent than gamma=.36 threshold0.9837, at the cost of stronger damping and p closer to0.5.

sample_design.confidence_proof: For three independent ±1 tomographic settings each measured n times, union of 3 two-sided Hoeffding bounds: |mean-true expectation|<=sqrt(2 ln(6/alpha)/n) simultaneously with probability>=1-alpha. Use lower bounds eta2,eta3,gamma to form an upper bound on W3. The fixed-axis witness is a sufficient test. This count assumes observed sample means equal the design expectation; it is not a guaranteed 1-alpha statistical power or an actual experiment.

three_time_Beyer_protocol.caveats: Accepted-event IID or conditional concentration bounds must be physically calibrated; source and detector loss/fair sampling not validated. This is a qubit-mode calculation that could use a qutrit block embedding, not intrinsically 3-level quantum memory. Even a W3 violation alone does not prove pairwise classicality without separately verified decompositions or tomography.
